style:
STYLE: premium product photography on a seamless infinite pure white studio sweep with an almost imperceptible cool grey falloff and no visible horizon. One single object floating in immaculate soft studio lighting, a gentle contact shadow beneath it and a subtle bright edge highlight along one side. Matte paper-white and cool pale grey materials, precisely machined surfaces, extreme negative space, absolute cleanliness. Calm, premium, deliberate, engineered.

PALETTE LOCK: pure white ground, matte white and cool pale grey objects, ONE deep graphite accent - no other colours, no warm tones, no gradients beyond the soft studio falloff.

NEGATIVE: readable text, letters, words, numbers, handwriting, people, faces, hands, desks, offices, chairs, plants, mugs, props, background objects, studio equipment, visible light stands, reflections of a studio, clutter, visible texture, film grain, colour, illustration, flat vector, line drawing, collage, cartoon, 3D cartoon render.
